title: Beautiful Auctionhouse
description:
An Serverwide Auctionhouse with inbuild GUI and Bank.
You exchange by Emeralds
body:
This is my Vibecoded Auctionhouse mod.
It is in early state.
You can exchange Currency to Emeralds and Emeralds to Currency (no real money).
The Tables cant be crafted, you have to spawn /give them with /give @p banktable etc.
You can set the amount of $ for each Emerald in the Config
Also you have commands to give you Bankcurrency. (future plan will may be only use Emeralds)
